annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision amending the list of harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds references such as EN ISO 3691-4:2023 for driverless industrial trucks, ISO 13849-1:2023 and ISO 25119, withdraws superseded ones, adds restrictions, and corrects classification errors. Compliance gives presumption of conformity.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes references of new harmonised standards, including EN ISO 3691-4:2023 on driverless industrial trucks, in the Official Journal.
Withdraws superseded or obsolete standards with deferred dates (2025-2027).
Restricts presumption of conformity for EN 15700:2023 and EN 15194:2017+A1:2023.
Corrects type classification of EN 1127-2 and EN ISO 11554.
Enters into force on publication, conferring presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC.
